text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I are on the way<n>back to campus
after going out.<n>Suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh! Look, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
On Rice Shower's outstretched finger<n>rests a very
small ladybug.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ladybugs are a sign of good luck. Did<n>you know
that?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time one's ever<n>landed on me...
Maybe something<n>good is going to happen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A bit later, Rice Shower stops at a<n>vending machine
to buy juice, when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no way! I won!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower blinks in surprise as the<n>word
“Winner” flickers vibrantly on<n>the vending
machine's display.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! I've never won anything<n>from a vending
machine before in my<n>life.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower hangs her head as if<n>she's uneasy for
some reason.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...I'm a little scared.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I have good luck now... that<n>probably means... I'm
going to bring<n>bad luck to everyone else later...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because... that's what always<n>happens.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But I think... what worries the most...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Is the fact that I always end up<n>having these
thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though something good<n>happened to me... and
I'm here with<n>you... I still think this way.
choice_data_list:
Well, you'll just have to create enough happiness
to offset that misfortune.

We can turn misfortune into memories too, you
know.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even though something good<n>happened to me... and
I'm here with<n>you... I still think this way.
choice_data_list:
Well, you'll just have to create enough happiness
to offset that misfortune.

We can turn misfortune into memories too, you

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...You're right. That is my goal, afterall.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I can't help but wonder... can I<n>really do it? Is it
pointless to even try?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I might not be able to do it on my own,<n>but maybe I
can do it with you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I might not be able to do it on my own,<n>but maybe I
can do it with you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Or at least, I will someday!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Rice Shower's feeling<n>more optimistic,
even if just a little.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Turn misfortune... into memories?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've never thought of it that way<n>before. Can you
really do that?
choice_data_list:
I'll turn any bad luck into a memory of being with
you.

I'll turn any bad luck into a memory of being with
you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: As long as you're with me, I'll try to<n>do the same...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: As long as you're with me, I'll try to<n>do the same...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: No... I will do the same.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower's expression lightens a<n>little.
